pair.title: Device pairing
pair.description:
Turn breezer to pair mode by holding button for more than 5 seconds for pairing with Home Assistant.

Make sure that there is no devices connected to breezer while adding it to Home Assistant.

![Location of button on bridge](/static/images/config_philips_hue.jpg)

pair_failed.title: Could not pair!
pair_failed.description:
Error occurs while pairing routine! Check logs for details.

Make sure that there is no devices connected to breezer while adding it to Home Assistant.

add_failed.title: Could not get test data from breezer!
add_failed.description:
Error occurs while getting data. May be you need pairing. Check logs for details.

Make sure that there is no devices connected to breezer while adding it to Home Assistant.

pair.title: Pair selected Bluetooth source
pair.description: The current Tion connection will be stopped before pairing. Put the breezer into pairing mode, then submit immediately. Pairing will use only the Bluetooth source selected on the previous screen.

pair_failed.title: Could not pair selected Bluetooth source
pair_failed.description: The pairing attempt failed and the existing Tion entry was restored. Check the Home Assistant logs, move the proxy closer to the breezer, and try again.

error.pair_source_required: Select a specific Bluetooth source before pairing.
error.unload_failed: The current Tion connection could not be stopped safely. Try again after its current update finishes.

abort.pair_successful: Bluetooth pairing completed. The Tion entry has been pinned to the selected source and started again.
Bluetooth pairing completed. The Tion entry has been pinned to the selected source and started again.
